row.evidence: ReadMe's pricing page lists 'SSO, OAuth, & more' only on Enterprise (Contact Us) and no SCIM on any plan; its docs say Single Sign-On is an Enterprise feature and a docs search for 'scim' returns no pages.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). Prices unchanged: Starter $0, Pro $250/mo billed annually (flat, 5 admins, $20 per additional admin), Enterprise Contact Us (annual only). June's 'Business+' tier and 'Enterprise starts $3,000+/mo' have no first-party source on the current pricing page and are dropped. SAML SSO (Enterprise) supports Okta, Google Workspace, Entra, Auth0 and JumpCloud via custom SAML apps; SAML sign-in creates members with no access, and Groups Mapping can assign project permissions (JIT-style). Okta's OIN ReadMe app is SWA only. No SCIM endpoint or teammate-management API found.

scim.notes: No SCIM anywhere in pricing, docs search or Enterprise user-management docs; recorded as none by absence.

user_api.notes: The ReadMe API (all plans) manages docs content, API keys, branches and child projects; the reference index lists no teammate/user-management endpoints.

okta.notes: OIN app marks SWA only; ReadMe's guide says not to use it and to build a custom SAML app instead.

jumpcloud.notes: ReadMe's SSO page lists a JumpCloud SAML guide (not loaded).

fallbacks.other_sync: SAML Groups Mapping assigns project permissions from the IdP groups attribute at sign-in
fallbacks.notes: A SAML sign-in creates a member with no project access; access comes from admin approval, invites or group mapping. No deprovisioning path documented.
